description: If \(|N|<|M|\), there is no embedding of the \(L\)-structure \(M\) into \(N\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.LargerModels.no_embedding_into_smaller.{u} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u} [L.Structure M]
